privacy.title: Your health, your data
privacy.description: Your medical data belongs to you. That's why your privacy matters to us. We follow European privacy laws (GDPR), and even go a step further:

termsAndConditions.title: Terms and conditions
termsAndConditions.fulltext:
Welcome to Ditto Care! We want you to understand your rights and our rights relating to the use of our app. Please review them carefully.

Here's a summary of some key terms:

1. Your data stays on your device - Your medical data is stored securely on your device, not on our servers.

2. Not medical advice - Ditto is a health self-management tool, not a medical device. Always consult healthcare professionals for medical advice.

3. Your data is yours - We don't train our AI on your data or use it for any purpose other than providing you the service.

4. AI processing - When you use AI features, your data is temporarily processed on secure EU servers and deleted immediately afterward.

5. Minimum age - You must be at least 16 years old to use the Ditto app.

6. You control sharing - Any sharing of your medical data is initiated by you manually.

7. Cancel anytime - You can delete your account at any time through the app settings.

8. AI quality and liability – We strive to make AI summaries as accurate as possible, but they may contain errors. Neither Ditto nor your healthcare professional is responsible for decisions made based on them.

9. We can suspend accounts - We may suspend accounts that violate our terms.

10. Dutch law applies - Any disputes will be resolved under Dutch law in Rotterdam courts.

superuserInvite.description: We appreciate you using Ditto for your care. That's why we'd love to talk to you personally to learn how we can make Ditto even better.
superuserInvite.cta: Contact us via WhatsApp if you'd like to contribute.
superuserInvite.whatsappMessage: Hi! I just received an invitation in Ditto to share my experiences. I'd love to participate! When could we schedule a conversation?

summaryNotPossible.title: Why is a summary not possible now?
summaryNotPossible.body: With every recorded conversation, Ditto checks whether a reliable summary is possible. For sensitive topics such as sexuality, self-harm, or end-of-life issues, we take extra care to prevent misunderstandings. Your audio recording and the transcript will always be available.
summaryNotPossible.body2: Sometimes Ditto is unnecessarily cautious. We understand that this can be frustrating. Therefore, Doctor Ditto can personally create a summary for you via WhatsApp. Please make sure to send the transcript of the conversation along with it.
summaryNotPossible.bullet1: By contacting us you give consent to use your transcript to help you. Read more in our privacy policy
summaryNotPossible.bullet2: The transcript will be deleted after 10 days and personal data will not be retained.
summaryNotPossible.disclaimer: Sharing a transcript can now only be done via WhatsApp.
summaryNotPossible.step1: First, press "Help via Whatsapp" to start a chat with Doctor Ditto.
summaryNotPossible.step2: Then, reopen the Ditto app and share your transcript from there.
summaryNotPossible.shareTip: To get help from Doctor Ditto you can share this transcript with us via Whatsapp. Tap the share Button, select Whatsapp and contact Ditto.
summaryNotPossible.body2ios: Sometimes Ditto is unnecessarily cautious. We understand that this can be frustrating. Therefore, Doctor Ditto can personally create a summary for you via WhatsApp.
summaryNotPossible.bottomDisclaimer: By using this service, you give consent for a Ditto doctor to create a summary. Your transcript will be deleted after 7 days and personal data will not be retained. This summary is not medical advice.
